subject: Interaction question about Neurolept-X
body_text:
Hello,

Is it safe to take Neurolept-X at the same time as a standard over-the-counter antihistamine? A patient asked me today and I would like to give an accurate answer. Also, should it be taken with food?

Thank you,
Fatima Al-Rashid, Pharmacist
City Health Pharmacy, Dubai, UAE
